name: single e-/e+
description: One electron per event, charge drawn per event from {e-, e+} with equal probability. Kinetic energy uniform in [1, 2000] MeV, isotropic direction. Charge is sampled rather than fixed because water Cherenkov light carries no charge information: e- and e+ of the same momentum are indistinguishable up to annihilation at rest, so a test set of one charge only measures half of what reconstruction is asked to do. Expressed through the bomb source with min_particles = max_particles = 1 -- a two-entry `particles` list would put BOTH charges in every event (generate_macro.py emits one /gun/addPrimary per entry), which is not the same sample.
